description: Free DVLA-backed check of a UK vehicle from its number plate: London ULEZ compliance, Clean Air Zone compliance, Scottish LEZ, MOT status and road tax status, plus make/colour confirmation. Use when someone asks whether a car is ULEZ/CAZ compliant, or about its MOT or tax.

vrn.description: UK number plate (VRN), e.g. KM71AEA. Spaces are fine.

name: check_vehicle
title: Check a UK vehicle by number plate
